name: clientforge
description: ClientForge — full-stack client, project & invoice OS (Angular + NestJS + Neon + Tailwind)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c teal,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=web && npm run build --workspace=api
scripts.start:prod: NODE_ENV=production PORT=8080 HOST=0.0.0.0 npm run start:prod --workspace=api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=api -- --tsc && cd apps/web && npx ng build --configuration=development --no-progress
